physicalVersioningModel.architecture: Separate Version Table Model (Stable Entity Anchor + Temporal Version Table)

states.stableIdentity: states.internal_id (UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE) & states.code (TEXT PK)
states.uniqueConstraints: EXCLUDE USING gist (state_internal_id WITH =, validity_interval WITH &&)
states.currentVersionResolution: states.current_version_id REFERENCES state_versions(id) OR state_versions.is_current = true (Partial Index)

districts.uniqueConstraints: EXCLUDE USING gist (district_id WITH =, validity_interval WITH &&)
districts.currentVersionResolution: districts.current_version_id REFERENCES district_versions(id) OR district_versions.is_current = true

parliamentaryConstituencies.uniqueConstraints: EXCLUDE USING gist (pc_id WITH =, validity_interval WITH &&)

constituencies.stableIdentity: constituencies.id (TEXT PK, legacy preserved) & constituencies.internal_id (UUID UNIQUE)
constituencies.uniqueConstraints: EXCLUDE USING gist (constituency_internal_id WITH =, validity_interval WITH &&)
constituencies.currentVersionResolution: constituencies.current_version_id REFERENCES constituency_versions(id) OR constituencies table holds active plane attributes

identityInvariants.RENAME: Same stable internal_id; new version row created; valid_to on old version set to transition date; valid_from on new version set to transition date; canonical code preserved or aliased.
identityInvariants.SPLIT: Parent stable entity continues with reduced boundary/new version; newly formed entity receives a distinct, globally unique stable internal_id and first version; lineage record links predecessor to successor with transition_type = 'split'.
identityInvariants.MERGE: Predecessor entity versions closed (valid_to = date); successor entity receives either new internal_id or absorbing internal_id; lineage records link all predecessors to successor with transition_type = 'merge'.
identityInvariants.ABOLITION: Stable entity internal_id retained indefinitely in catalog (protecting domain FKs); active version closed with valid_to = date; is_current set to false; no new version created.
identityInvariants.CREATION: New stable internal_id generated; first version created with valid_from = date and valid_to = NULL; lineage records predecessor if formed from territory of existing entity.

canonicalCodeSemantics.internalStableIdentity: internal_id (UUID): Globally unique, immutable, permanent system anchor.
canonicalCodeSemantics.canonicalApplicationCode: canonical_code (VARCHAR): Formatted system identifier (e.g. 'TS-AC-001'). Stable within a delimitation regime; subject to versioned aliasing if statutory renumbering occurs.
canonicalCodeSemantics.externalAuthorityIdentifier: LGD Code (MoPR), Census 2011 Code (RGI), ECI Code (Election Commission). Authority-specific, versioned per external catalog.
canonicalCodeSemantics.displayName: Localized display string (English, Telugu, etc.). Mapped per version.

temporalInvariants.intervalSemantics: [valid_from, valid_to) half-open interval. valid_from inclusive, valid_to exclusive.
temporalInvariants.nullValidTo: Represents currently active, open-ended validity extending indefinitely into the future until legally superseded.
temporalInvariants.adjacentIntervalRule: V1.valid_to = V2.valid_from = transition_date. Zero gap, zero overlap.
temporalInvariants.overlapExclusion: EXCLUDE USING gist (entity_internal_id WITH =, daterange(valid_from, valid_to, '[)') WITH &&)
temporalInvariants.currentVersionInvariant: At most one version per entity can have is_current = true (or valid_to IS NULL). Enforced via UNIQUE partial index on entity_id WHERE is_current = true.
temporalInvariants.scenarioIsolation: Scenario records must NEVER participate in canonical temporal exclusion indexes; partitioned by scenario_id or stored in separate tables.

delimitationRegimeModel.CURRENT_LEGAL_REGIME: Delimitation of Parliamentary and Assembly Constituencies Order, 2008. Legally active.
delimitationRegimeModel.FUTURE_ANTICIPATED_REGIME: Post-2026 Delimitation (Article 82/170 constitutional mandate). Legally prospective, un-enacted.
delimitationRegimeModel.SCENARIO_PROPOSED_REGIME: Simulation models, draft commission proposals. Non-statutory, strictly UNVERIFIED.

scenarioIsolationInvariants.scenarioToCanonicalFk: PERMITTED (Scenario entities may point to canonical entities as predecessors).
scenarioIsolationInvariants.canonicalToScenarioFk: STRICTLY PROHIBITED (Zero foreign keys on canonical tables pointing to scenario tables).
scenarioIsolationInvariants.statusRestriction: Scenario records permanently restricted to status = 'UNVERIFIED' or 'SCENARIO'; NEVER 'OFFICIAL'.
scenarioIsolationInvariants.publicVisibilityRestriction: Canonical public endpoints query only is_scenario = false or query tables with 0 scenario records.
scenarioIsolationInvariants.identityReuseRestriction: Scenario entities must NEVER reuse canonical internal_id or canonical_code.
scenarioIsolationInvariants.promotionRestriction: No direct automated or RPC promotion of scenarios to official. Requires separate statutory gazette ingestion.

jobBoundary.W014_IN_SCOPE: Temporal validity intervals, regime models, predecessor/successor lineage, temporal relationship mapping, scenario isolation.
jobBoundary.W014_EXCLUDED: Spatial containment (ST_Contains), polygon intersections (ST_Intersects), topology graphs, H3 indexing, geometry reconciliation (Quarantined to W015/W016).
